title: Reconcile the complete current Executive Office component roster
summary: Enumerate EOP components using statutes, appropriations, organizational materials, and official office pages rather than treating the six-link White House landing page as exhaustive.

provenance.method: free-range five-role primary-source review and bounded graph synthesis

workflow.next_action: Enumerate statutory and appropriated EOP components.

data.target: Current Executive Office of the President component roster
data.research_question: Which offices and councils are legally and operationally components of the EOP as of August 2026, and which are merely linked on the White House EOP landing page?
hypotheses: The six-link landing page is not exhaustive.
Appropriations and statutory materials identify additional components.
objectives: Distinguish EOP components, White House Office staff, cabinet-level agencies, and advisory bodies.
Record creation, abolition, renaming, and acting leadership dates.
